rules: Only variables from admissible_pre_trader_modules may enter the Observation Engine, Market State, Regime Model, or physical forecast P.
Decision and Output variables are downstream Trader or reporting fields and may not be forecast sensors.
A dictionary change requires a new source hash, manifest version, measurement dictionary version, and reproducibility test.
Research and Institutional variables may be unavailable without being imputed silently.
Normalization state must be versioned independently of the dictionary and fitted without future data.
